- **Patron** (person) — "Borrows books at the library."
- **Library** (software system) — "Manages books and loans."
- Relationship: Patron → Library, "Browses the catalogue through" [HTTPS]

part.text:
The images are ready. ✅

**`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the workspace defines exactly one view (`SystemContext`), so there's one image:

- **Patron** (person, `#084270`) → **Library** (software system, `#1168bd`)
- Relationship: "Browses the catalogue through" [HTTPS]
- Left-to-right layout matching the view's `autoLayout` setting, with title and a C4 legend

A note on method: this environment has no diagram renderer (no Java/Node/Python/Graphviz) and no network access, so I couldn't run PlantUML or Mermaid CLI. Instead I exported the view's canonical content via the Structurizr tools and hand-built the SVG using the official C4 color palette and shapes — it's valid, well-formed XML (tag balance verified) and will render in any browser or SVG viewer. If you'd prefer PNG, let me know and I can look into options, but SVG is the lossless format here.

Also, for reference, the Structurizr inspector flagged a few non-blocking recommendations (no workspace scope set, system missing documentation/decisions, and the two containers aren't on any view) — none of which affect this render, but worth knowing if you extend the model.
